notes: The battery commander's sequence on receiving a task (simcore/campaign/battery_plan.hpp). The steps and their order are the textbook's; the book gives no times, so each step's full and short times are SAM3D estimates. Short of time he works every step toward its short time in one proportion; political work, last in the book's list, is a line in the debrief only.
source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 240-245 (the commander's sequence: task, time, preliminary orders, situation, decision, reconnaissance, the oral combat order, support, political work)

steps.en: understands the task: what is covered, from what, by when, with whom
steps.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p240 (the step); sam3d estimate (its times)

steps.en: works out the time: the ready-by, the march, the position's preparation
steps.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p240 (the step); sam3d estimate (its times)

steps.en: gives the preliminary order: the vehicles to prepare for the march
steps.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p240 (preliminary orders to the vehicle commanders); sam3d estimate (the times; the words are data/crew/pu12m_crew.json's)

steps.en: assesses the situation on the working map
steps.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 240-241 (the step and the working map's contents); sam3d estimate (its times)

steps.en: decides: the positions, each launcher's sector, the emission regime, the dummies
steps.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p243 (the decision's contents); sam3d estimate (its times)
voenizdat_osa_1991 p243 (reconnaissance of the position); sam3d estimate (its times: a drive there and back with the vehicle commanders)

steps.en: gives the oral combat order to the vehicle commanders
steps.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p243 (the decision given as an oral combat order); sam3d estimate (the times; the words are data/crew/pu12m_crew.json's)

steps.en: organises support: the reloads, fuel, communications, the observation post
steps.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p240 (the step); sam3d estimate (its times, worked while the battery marches)

occupy_s.source: ru_pu12_text (the post's full deployment within 18 min: the longest of the battery's, so the battery is ready when its post is); voenizdat_osa_1991 p231 (the launchers into combat order in 35-50 s, deployed well inside it)
occupy_s.notes: From the head's arrival to the battery commander's «к бою готова» up to the regiment. The source describes the later PU-12 build; the PU-12M's own figure is not known. pu12m_mission_cover's run: the post ready about 17 min after its arrival, the R-111 tuned last.
